style.styleTitle: Personalised Christmas Wreath Glass Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Add a festive finishing touch to your Christmas décor with this Personalised Christmas Wreath Glass Bauble. Featuring an elegant wreath design, this beautiful glass decoration can be personalised with 5 lines of custom text (up to 12 characters per line), making it a thoughtful Christmas gift or treasured keepsake. Perfect for hanging on the tree, gifting to loved ones or adding to seasonal displays, this personalised bauble brings a classic, sparkling and timeless feel to any festive home. Dimensions(mm): Height: 80 Width: 100 Depth: 80.
